title: 日本ダービーの後に・525mの青春

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is over. Mejiro Ryan and Ines Fujin are met with unsparing applause from the audience who just witnessed their fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having regained her confidence from the heated race, Mejiro Ryan is more motivated than ever for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, also having watched the race, ponders her upcoming matchup against the improved capability of Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're midway through the Classics, and more tough races lie ahead for Ryan in the fall.
